text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe...
I'm sorry, I lost again.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I trained so hard
thinking this would be the time, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: Don't let your spirit break, too!
Don't let your spirit be defeated too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah! Thank you so much!
It's really reassuring hearing that from you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You're right, my dream
isn't just mine alone anymore.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to switch gears!
Let's do our best together again starting tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...It's just as you say.
If I give up, that's when I truly lose...!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll never give up on winning in the races I love!
Starting today, I'm going to give it my all toward taking 1st place again!
